name: Sarah Jenkins
inquiry_text: We operate a fleet of 450 freight trucks and handle over 2,000 dispatch tickets and customer status inquiries daily. Our support team is completely overwhelmed by repetitive status calls. We want to architect an autonomous AI multi-agent workflow that ingests telematics data, handles freight dispatch status autonomously, and routes complex exceptions to human dispatchers. We need an end-to-end partner who understands enterprise LLMs, API integrations, and robust cloud deployment.
notes: Excellent match for Cynbit's Autonomous AI Agents & Cloud Infrastructure domain.

name: Rajiv Mehra
inquiry_text: We manage 18 residential apartment complexes across Gurgaon and Jaipur with approximately 1,200 tenants. Managing rent collection across individual bank transfers and fielding manual maintenance complaints over WhatsApp has become unmanageable. We saw your TenantEase product and want to explore if we can deploy TenantEase across our portfolio with custom WhatsApp payment reminder integrations and an owner analytics dashboard.
notes: Direct fit for Cynbit's TenantEase product and custom API services.

We noticed your work with Evento handling 50k+ users and want an engineering team with equal architectural rigor to build our core lending engine.
expected_fit: Tier 1 - High Value Cloud & Full-Stack Deal
notes: Strong match for Cynbit's Full-Stack and AWS Zero-Trust Cloud engineering.
